steps.title: Once you have a ring of …
steps.text: Once you have a ring of suffering & Necklace of Anguish we can kill Zulrah fairly safely. However the food drops were nerfed so it may be worth grinding slightly better food as Zulrah can hit hard and you are close to a lot of more dangerous PvM. Anglerfish are very good for almost any and all instances of late game PvM but require 82 Fishing & 84 Cooking to obtain. I would recommend knocking this out to get it done at either Tempoross (Max XP method) or 3t Barbarian Fishing. If you afked Karambwans a lot you will probably have 70+ right now so barb fishing is very good. 82 Fishing is about a 20 hour grind. Anglerfish are good for Zulrah, Doom, Yama & ToB. Alternatively Zulrah is still accessible with Potatoes & Cheese with Karambwan combo eats as long as you are disciplined on teleports if you get spammed with range attacks.
